reason: Clarify 'previous eligible trading day' so daily delta-basis cannot span the preregistered roll-risk exclusion window.

clarification.previous_basis_day: The immediately preceding valid Nikkei cash trading day in the public cash-price calendar.
clarification.requirement: Both current signal day and immediately preceding cash trading day must lie outside the quarterly roll-risk exclusion window.
clarification.post_roll_behavior: The first cash trading day after a roll-risk window has no signal if its immediately preceding cash trading day is still inside the excluded window.
